Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Chest of Drawers with Diamond Pattern, 17.7 Inch Width, Natural
Materials: Birch
The diamond-pattern woodwork in this solid-hardwood cabinet gives it a bold, modern look. Gold metal legs and drawer pulls complement the natural warmth of the birch, and the smooth ball-bearing drawer glides make storage easy. 36.38"W x 17.7"D x 31.5"H Solid hardwood cabinet with birch ply concave diamond designs in drawer fronts; gold metal legs and drawer pulls The clean styling and diamond pattern woodwork on drawer fronts give this a modern look. The three drawers are great to hide away items like clothes, table linens, and even board games. This piece features ball-bearing drawer glides. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
